describes: Current form tools, direct design verbs, widget lending, page-space hits and pointer placement.

cases.name: init-without-annotation
cases.covers: Current connect registers fill/edit and all seven palette tools on the actual interaction hub.

cases.name: init-with-annotation
cases.covers: Palette tools join annotation.tools; widgets lend in design mode and return to form fill mode.

cases.name: place-a-text-field
cases.covers: Current create accepts page-space drafts and explicit names. The handler owns auto-naming; engine answers fold without geometry reloads.

cases.name: place-each-family
cases.covers: Current direct drafts retain radio exportValue and complete choice options, and return complete family-specific fields/widgets.

cases.name: placement-before-the-snapshot
cases.covers: The actual handler names against the current view while the first list is pending; create shows after confirmation and remains after the snapshot loads.

cases.name: placement-is-page-bound
cases.covers: Actual gesture placement clamps overshoots, ignores degenerate drags and unknown pages, and permits one-point geometry.

cases.name: placement-refused-by-the-engine
cases.covers: A current create refusal rejects without confirmation; the next create succeeds with its own allocated refs.

cases.name: placement-reloads-the-annotation-page
cases.covers: Current confirmed widget rows are lent directly to annotation in design mode; selection needs no extra annotation read.

cases.name: page-box
cases.covers: The host page box is in current page-space coordinates; unknown pages return null.

cases.name: update-field
cases.covers: Current update stages a patch against an actual field ref and folds the answer; a named engine family refusal rejects.

cases.name: delete-field
cases.covers: Deleting a spread field removes its widgets on both pages from form and annotation lending. Unknown ref deletion is an explicit engine not-found refusal.

cases.name: queued-verbs-interleave-with-page-reloads
cases.covers: Current structural ops overlap without old page reloads; a confirmed update remains while a prior delete awaits its answer.

cases.name: delete-field-without-annotation
cases.covers: Direct delete works with no annotation plugin; a later engine not-found refusal is preserved.

cases.name: detach-widget
cases.covers: Current removeWidget takes field and annotation refs; detached rows remain on the page with field:null and are no longer projected as fields.

cases.name: widget-hit-test
cases.covers: Current model hit test returns the smallest owned widget; unowned widgets and unknown pages return null before and after ensureLoaded.

cases.name: widget-hit-test-live-boxes-compare-areas
cases.covers: Current snapshot hit test compares area and preserves first-listed ties; removed live fallback has the same surviving geometric owner.

cases.name: widget-hit-test-without-annotation
cases.covers: Before the current form snapshot lands no widget can hit; after it lands the model hits without annotation.

cases.name: attach-widget
cases.covers: Current addWidget creates another placement on the field, allocates its real ref and inherits look; a refused follow-up is explicit.

cases.name: place-with-a-name-and-options
cases.covers: Current explicit create supports custom choice names/options and signature fields without a stale placeField door.

cases.name: a-click-places-the-tool-default
cases.covers: A real pointer click creates the default text tool draft and selects the final allocated widget in design mode.

cases.name: a-click-near-the-edge-is-clamped
cases.covers: The real listbox tool click clamps its standard size to the page edge.

cases.name: a-thin-drag-is-a-drag
cases.covers: Without annotation a 100 by 2 drag commits its exact page-space rectangle and the tool static look.

cases.name: the-home-page-tracks-through-the-projection
cases.covers: Cross-page moves use the serialized projection callable, null projections are ignored, and gap releases use the last resolved home-page point.

cases.name: the-live-preview
cases.covers: The real form placement handler updates annotation page items past the shared drag threshold and clears its preview on release.

cases.name: the-click-threshold-is-strict
cases.covers: Exactly three points is a drag; degenerate dimensions produce no placement or engine call.

cases.name: the-handler-outranks-lower-priorities
cases.covers: The actual priority95 form handler captures before a priority50 observer and reports form-place in gesture events.

cases.name: the-handler-declines
cases.covers: The real handler declines gaps, unknown palette tools, missing design authority and a replacement tool without form-place.

cases.name: auto-select-waits-for-a-stable-world
cases.covers: Reserved object numbers make pending selection immediate; switching tools clears it. The next two immediate engine answers publish another-page/no-widget facts synchronously during stage/apply before form.get, so those authored outcomes stay unselected.

cases.name: a-failed-placement-is-logged
cases.covers: The current handler silently skips too-thin clamped geometry and unknown pages, and contains an exact engine refusal via console.error.
